linked_issue.title: Unify Fractal graph UI on the canonical ExecutionGraphPreview renderer (external repos)

boundary.controlplane_contributes: handoff record only; no UI files, no browser-serving code, no sibling-repository mutation
boundary.survey_mode: read-only (git rev-parse, ls-files, status, cmp, grep, sed only)

repositories.name: fractalsociety/website
repositories.role: owner of canonical ExecutionGraphPreview renderer and shared projection + design-token package
repositories.blocker: packages/fractal-graph-ui exists only as UNTRACKED working-tree state (git ls-files is empty; status reports '?? packages/fractal-graph-ui/'), so no committed revision exists for consumers to depend on -> shared-package-published FAILS. Its src/index.ts GRAPH_LENSES (lines 21-29) declares ids 'economics' and 'memory' where the lens contract requires 'resource_economic' and 'memory_knowledge' -> lens-contract FAILS at the source of truth. The canonical renderer apps/dashboard/components/projects/ExecutionGraphPreview.tsx IS tracked and already imports projectGraphInput from '@fractalwork/fractal-graph-ui' (line 9), so only the package commit and lens-id fix are needed. This is the critical-path root for all downstream steps.

repositories.name: fractalsociety/fractal-cli
repositories.role: consumer; retires duplicate static renderer under execution-graph/
repositories.blocker: execution-graph/ vendors UNTRACKED byte-identical copies of the website package static assets (cmp-verified: execution-graph/fractal-graph-ui.js == packages/fractal-graph-ui/static/fractal-graph-ui.js; execution-graph/fractal-graph-ui.css == static/fractal-graph-ui.css, plus vendor/) instead of importing the shared package -> token-contract FAILS. Tracked duplicate sources to retire at step (b): execution-graph/app.js, index.html, master-graph.js, master-graph.css, styles.css, tests/test_master_graph.js (tracked dir also holds README.md, server.py, task-state.py, graph-state*.json, assets/, tests/*.py which are removed with the duplicate surface). Retirement step (b) is gated on step (a) plus green visual-parity and e2e gates.

repositories.name: fractalsociety/fractalmaster
repositories.role: consumer; retires execution-graph/ and intelligence_graph/web/ LAST, and owns the typed snapshot/query adapters
repositories.blocker: The seven-lens source of truth is still intelligence_graph/web/app.js (LENS_BUTTONS lines 12-18 carry all seven contract ids/labels; overview fallback at line 60; ?lens= URL handling at line 717) while the shared package lens ids are wrong, so seven-lens parity has no authoritative counterpart yet. Adapters remain untyped dict/Mapping shaping: intelligence_graph/lens_snapshot.py (454 lines) and intelligence_graph/views/voice_query.py (702 lines) -> typed-adapters NOT STARTED. No visual-parity harness, screenshot baseline, or playwright/percy config is tracked in any UI-bearing repository -> no pre-migration reference exists; visual-parity and e2e gates NOT STARTED. The 83-path dirty tree means no clean revision represents the migration state. Retirement steps (c) and (d) blocked; intelligence_graph/web/ retires LAST only after seven-lens parity is proven.

repositories.name: fractalsociety/fractal-voice
repositories.role: rebuild target for Fractal Voice on the unified projection
repositories.blocker: main tracks only .gitignore, README.md, and SECURITY.md (git ls-files) - there is no Voice implementation to migrate, so Fractal Voice must be REBUILT against the unified projection and the typed query adapter, replacing the current fractalmaster voice_query path. voice-rebuild NOT STARTED and is blocked on step (a) plus the typed adapters; Voice counts as migrated only when its e2e gate passes on the shared projection.

intended_outcomes: One canonical renderer: ExecutionGraphPreview in fractalsociety-website is the only Fractal graph renderer; no second renderer implementation anywhere

Shared projection + design-token package: one versioned package (packages/fractal-graph-ui, @fractalwork/fractal-graph-ui) exports graph projection types and design tokens; consumers import, never re-declare
Seven intelligence lenses preserved exactly (ids and labels above); ?lens= deep link and unknown-lens fallback to overview keep working

Typed snapshot/query adapters: lens snapshot producer (fractalmaster intelligence_graph/lens_snapshot.py) and voice query compiler (intelligence_graph/views/voice_query.py) get typed, versioned adapter contracts against the shared projection package; untyped ad-hoc JSON shaping removed
Visual-parity gate: automated check of the unified renderer against the pre-migration reference for all seven lenses; must pass before any duplicate source is retired
End-to-end gate: e2e run loads a real snapshot through the typed adapters into the canonical renderer in each consumer surface, asserting node/edge counts, lens switching, and detail rendering
Duplicate-source retirement in strict gated order (see retirement_order); intelligence_graph/web/ retires LAST
Fractal Voice rebuilt on the unified projection and typed query adapter; migrated only when its e2e gate passes on the shared projection

retirement_order.action: Harden canonical ExecutionGraphPreview and commit/publish packages/fractal-graph-ui (fixing GRAPH_LENSES ids to the contract set); blocked first

Consume the shared package, then delete execution-graph/ duplicates (app.js, index.html, master-graph.js, master-graph.css, styles.css, tests/test_master_graph.js and the rest of the duplicate surface); gated on step a plus parity+e2e
Consume the shared package, then delete fractalmaster/execution-graph/; gated on step a plus parity+e2e
retirement_order.note: requires a clean committed migration revision; tree currently has 83 dirty paths

retirement_order.action: Retire intelligence_graph/web/ LAST, only after seven-lens parity is proven against it as the current source of truth for lens behavior
